records.head: 277efc5b389acd2b9699c9b25baf83450274096f
records.title: Retry stalled DNS-SD resolution with finite deadlines and explicit operation ownership

prefill_parameters.title: Retry stalled DNS-SD resolution with finite deadlines and explicit operation ownership
prefill_parameters.bug-description:
## Current behavior

Reviewed original stable source: `cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c`.

Discovery starts one resolve for each advertised instance and keeps its slot while that advertisement remains present. A missing completion, an error completion, or a null result does not schedule another attempt. Renewed positive PTR records extend the advertisement expiry while the existing slot suppresses another resolve. A receiver can therefore remain unresolved despite continuing advertisements.

This is a source-derived failure path, not a claim that Windows drops callbacks in a particular network incident. Current stable already removes resolve slots on PTR removal, advertisement expiry and browse restart; it should not be described as unconditionally stuck until application restart.

Relevant original source:

- [PTR handling and existing-slot suppression](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/desktop/AirFlash.App/Services/WindowsDiscovery.cs#L129).
- [Error/null completion and retained slot](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/desktop/AirFlash.App/Services/WindowsDiscovery.cs#L166).
- [Advertisement expiry and operation disposal](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/desktop/AirFlash.App/Services/WindowsDiscovery.cs#L187).

## Reproduction and expected behavior

Use an injected DNS-SD boundary and monotonic clock: advertise a synthetic instance, withhold its resolve completion, then renew the PTR before its TTL expires. In current stable, there is no resolve deadline or retry while the slot survives. Repeat with an error or null completion. No receiver or live network is needed to exercise this control flow.

Expected behavior is a finite logical attempt followed by bounded retry/backoff while the name remains advertised. Cache TTL, advertisement state, pending request token, browse epoch and resource ownership must remain separate. An obsolete callback must neither publish stale records nor clear a newer attempt, including within the same epoch.

## Bounded fix and acceptance

- Add finite initial/refresh deadlines, bounded backoff and coordinator/per-name/shared owner limits. Preserve selected-interface pause without fallback, manual receiver persistence and existing catalog identities.
- Run each native resolve in a finite helper that dispatches before WPF, logging, settings or audio initialization. Root its owner before starting it. An unstarted owner with no associated process may settle directly; once a child may have started, release capacity only after successfully observing that exact child's exit. A reply, deadline, cancel/kill result or failed exit wait is insufficient. Retain uncertain owners within the shared bound.
- Keep browse cancellation separate. [Microsoft documents a final `ERROR_CANCELLED` browse callback](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/windns/nf-windns-dnsservicebrowsecancel); settle its inputs only after the terminal indication and the implementation's tracked native calls/managed callback sections have ended. [ResolveCancel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/windns/nf-windns-dnsserviceresolvecancel) provides no equivalent callback-quiescence guarantee, so a successful-looking return alone must not justify reclaiming resolve inputs.
- Cover inline/missing/late callbacks, failed Start/Cancel/Kill/exit observation, both timeout/completion orders, expiry/removal/new PTR, old tokens/epochs, Restart/Dispose and repeated bounded attempts. Assert exact settlement and that observer failures or reentrant publication do not abandon detached work.

## Verification and limits

A historical [cancellation/publication fixture failure](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/actions/runs/38134996290) was investigated separately from its [later documentation-only green run](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/actions/runs/38135036967). Controlled scheduling exposed a fake cancellation drainer synchronously joining its own callback; [the fixture correction](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/commit/68cae6f) exercises both deferred-drain winners. That establishes a fixture defect, not a production deadlock or a Windows callback-loss diagnosis.

Logical-state and resource fixtures, plus actual synthetic helper-process checks, provide the relevant verification paths. Browse fixtures establish settlement of tracked native calls and managed callback sections; they do not independently establish native callback return-stack quiescence beyond the documented terminal callback contract. Earlier in-process resolve reclamation and a bounded retained-owner prototype were superseded; their apparent zero-owner results do not establish the helper design's lifetime safety. Final standalone branch qualification must bind results to its exact commit. Combined-fork test/package results are not standalone branch proof. Real-network reliability, receiver behavior and helper startup cost on every machine remain unqualified.

## Prepared implementation and executed verification

The prepared implementation is [codex/fix-discovery-resolve](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/tree/277efc5b389acd2b9699c9b25baf83450274096f), commit `277efc5b389acd2b9699c9b25baf83450274096f`, independently based on the original stable source above. Independent final source/regression review found no unresolved findings.

Fresh standalone Release build passed with zero warnings/errors; all **295 Core tests** passed with no skips. Separate isolated WPF runs passed **568 assertions each in 3 catalog/region combinations**, covering English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. These are this branch’s results, separate from combined-fork qualification.

Six actual synthetic DNS helper processes also passed reply/watchdog/kill/parent-settlement checks with zero parent native owners. No live DNS or receiver incident was used.
prefill_parameters.reproduction-steps:
1. Inject a DNS-SD boundary and monotonic clock.
2. Advertise a synthetic instance; withhold resolve completion.
3. Renew positive PTR before expiry and advance beyond the expected deadline.
4. Repeat with error/null completion; inspect attempts, publication and retained native/process ownership.
This is a conditional source-derived path, with no live network incident claimed.
prefill_parameters.windows-version: Windows 11 Pro Insider Preview, OS build 26220 (isolated local fixtures); hosted Windows 2025 where stated

records.head: 7dfcbb27331c700846c552de28e8eef882c57cf6
records.title: Normalize accepted pairing PINs and preserve credential lookup errors

prefill_parameters.title: Normalize accepted pairing PINs and preserve credential lookup errors
prefill_parameters.bug-description:
## Current behavior

Reviewed original stable source: `cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c`.

The PIN dialog accepts ASCII digits and dashes, enables Pair when there are four to eight digits, and returns the original text. Native pairing requires four to eight digit bytes. A synthetic input such as `12-34` is therefore enabled by the desktop but rejected by native validation.

Credential loading separately uses `Path::exists()` before opening the accessory's file. A metadata/access failure can be collapsed to false and returned as credential absence. Playback then selects transient pair-setup. Failures after a successful existence probe already propagate, and pair-verify failure already does not fall back to transient setup; the defect is the uncertain-presence classification.

Relevant original source:

- [PIN editing and enablement](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/desktop/AirFlash.App/Ui/PinDialog.cs#L18-L23), [unchanged submitted text](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/desktop/AirFlash.App/Ui/PinDialog.cs#L31-L36).
- [Strict native PIN validation](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/native/airflash-engine/src/auth.rs#L113-L117).
- [Boolean existence probe and credential loading](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/native/airflash-engine/src/credentials.rs#L105), [authentication selection](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/native/airflash-engine/src/session.rs#L229).

## Reproduction and expected behavior

Use a real modal dialog with a fake pairing connection: enter `12-34`, submit Pair and inspect the actual `pair_pin` payload. The required payload is `1234`. This is a deterministic input/command fixture, not a real accessory pairing observation.

Use injected credential-open/read failures and a temporary synthetic store. Initial NotFound should establish absence; PermissionDenied/other open errors and every read-stage failure should remain errors and initiate no authentication exchange. Valid saved credentials should select verify exactly once; genuine absence should select transient exactly once.

## Bounded fix and acceptance

- Use one ASCII normalizer for button enablement, final submission validation and the returned PIN: remove permitted ASCII dashes, then require four to eight ASCII digits within the existing editing bound. Keep native validation strict.
- Cover typing, selection replacement, paste, leading zeros, length boundaries, letters, whitespace, Unicode digits/characters, Cancel and token timeout. Assert actual fake command payloads and no following playback after cancelled pairing. Single-line WPF paste may truncate a newline suffix before validation; distinguish that textbox result from directly supplied invalid text.
- Open the credential file once and read that opened object with a finite size bound. Only initial open NotFound selects absence. Preserve original open/read/DPAPI/format/JSON/identity errors; failed verify must never select another authentication method.
- Preserve current-user DPAPI, the existing versioned file format, accessory `/info deviceID` keys, normalization and atomic replacement. Do not introduce plaintext backups or catalog-key migration.
- Verify synthetic saved-file replacement, path disappearance after opening, oversize data, tampering, malformed protected payloads and both loaded-credential/absent method selections.

## Verification and limits

Existing receiver-free modal and native loader/authentication fixtures provide the acceptance paths. A [source-equivalent error-hiding lookup control](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/actions/runs/38162296485) fails the decisive initial-open assertion with controls passing; it is a mutation, not literal execution of the unchanged loader. Historical modal and Windows-native checks remain bound to their recorded source commits. Final standalone qualification must test the exact prepared branch; combined-fork suites/packages do not prove this branch independently.

Missing/non-string/empty playback `/info deviceID` retains the existing no-lookup transient path; that identity policy is outside this fix. Preserving storage errors does not promise every error is classified as `authentication_failed`. Prompt-open engine fault ordering, general IPC reader/liveness changes and real accessory PIN policy are separate concerns. No real credential store, receiver or pairing exchange is required for these tests.

## Prepared implementation and executed verification

The prepared implementation is [codex/fix-auth-input](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/tree/7dfcbb27331c700846c552de28e8eef882c57cf6), commit `7dfcbb27331c700846c552de28e8eef882c57cf6`, independently based on the original stable source above. Independent final source/regression review found no unresolved findings.

Fresh standalone Release build passed with zero warnings/errors; all **223 Core tests** passed with no skips. Separate isolated WPF runs passed **686 assertions each in 3 catalog/region combinations**, covering English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. These are this branch’s results, separate from combined-fork qualification.

[Exact-source Windows validation](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/actions/runs/38359126296) checked out this commit and passed **59 native tests**, Clippy, native Release build and the executable compatibility audit, plus the branch’s managed build/Core suite. Two existing tests remain ignored: recording-endpoint qualification and the thirty-minute localhost soak.

The exact-source hosted modal paste harness passed **225 assertions**. Two controlled PIN-deadline/lifetime-Stop cases distinguish Error after joined cleanup from Idle cancellation, with no PIN/start command or subsequent playback. Their initial failure was a fixture cancellation-registration lifetime race; the corrected signal remains registered until cleanup is joined, without changing production classification.
prefill_parameters.reproduction-steps:
1. Open the real modal PIN dialog with a fake pairing connection.
2. Submit 12-34 and inspect the actual pair_pin payload (expected1234).
3. Inject initial-open PermissionDenied versus genuine NotFound, plus read/DPAPI/parse errors in a temporary synthetic credential store.
4. Assert only genuine absence selects transient setup and errors initiate no alternate authentication exchange.
prefill_parameters.windows-version: Windows 11 Pro Insider Preview, OS build 26220 (isolated local fixtures); hosted Windows 2025 where stated

records.head: 421e1ea8159803fbc339dff3782b1858e8a797d4
records.title: Preserve process IPC rejection details and report actual equalizer preparation acceptance

prefill_parameters.title: Preserve process IPC rejection details and report actual equalizer preparation acceptance
prefill_parameters.bug-description:
## Current behavior

Reviewed original stable source: `cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c`.

Native malformed/oversized command rejection emits a version-1 error with explicit empty request/session strings, `command_error`, `ipc`, null host and false retryability. Desktop playback/Pair filtering requires the active session id, so it discards this process-owned rejection. The original detail can be replaced by a later read timeout, and retry policy can then treat it as a different failure.

The equalizer mailbox separately ignores nonnewer sequence updates, but the command handler still emits `equalizer_changed` with metadata prepared from the submitted request. A stale or conflicting request can therefore receive success describing preparation that was not retained.

Relevant original source:

- [Error envelope](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/native/airflash-engine/src/main.rs#L22), [empty-correlated command rejection](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/native/airflash-engine/src/main.rs#L89).
- [Desktop session filtering](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/desktop/AirFlash.Core/SessionController.cs#L442-L454), [Pair reading, PIN wait and error handling](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/desktop/AirFlash.Core/SessionController.cs#L405-L423).
- [Mailbox ignores nonnewer updates](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/native/airflash-engine/src/equalizer.rs#L133), [handler replies from submitted preparation](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/native/airflash-engine/src/main.rs#L185).

## Reproduction and expected behavior

Use a fake owning engine connection to inject the exact empty-correlated rejection during startup, connecting, streaming and Pair before PIN is requested. Inspect the displayed failure, structured diagnostics, cleanup and process count with force reconnect enabled. Required behavior is the original IPC cause and false retryability, without an unrelated timeout retry. Near matches and ordinary stale-session events must retain normal filtering.

Use the production EQ handler and a synthetic live mailbox: submit `10/A`, `9/B`, `10/B`, `10/A`, `11/B`. Assert serialized replies together with retained sequence/preparation. A stale update and same-sequence conflict must not claim success or alter the mailbox; an identical prepared-value replay is idempotent. Successful metadata must describe retained preparation.

These are deterministic parser/controller/mailbox cases. They establish conditional source defects, not the frequency of malformed commands or a receiver dropout cause.

## Bounded fix and acceptance

- Recognize only the defined process-owned rejection shape before ordinary session filtering, including startup hello. Preserve detail, code, channel and retryability through playback and Pair diagnostics; obsolete owners cannot record or publish faults.
- Convert malformed/non-object desktop output into a controlled final IPC protocol failure. Preserve cancellation and normal stale/version filtering, and keep EQ feedback nonfatal.
- Return mailbox outcome and retained preparation atomically: Accepted, Idempotent, Stale or Conflict. Prepared-value equality includes gain, bypass, coefficients and headroom.
- Retain compatible `equalizer_changed` for accepted/idempotent results. Use existing nonfatal `equalizer_error` for stale/conflicting requests, echoing the submitted sequence/message without success headroom fields. Preparation acceptance does not acknowledge DSP pickup or crossfade completion.
- Cover both sample rates, invalid structures/gains/sequences, wrong or absent sessions, pair/probe slots and a subsequent valid command. Actual receiver-free child parser tests must verify the existing 65,536-byte command limit including newline and recovery with hello/EOF.

## Verification and limits

Historical Core fixtures against unchanged stable runtime separate expected failures from healthy controls. A [source-equivalent EQ reply control](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/actions/runs/38165179020) fails the decisive serialized reply assertion with library controls passing. Existing parser children start no receiver/capture worker. Final standalone qualification must bind managed/native results to the prepared branch's exact commit; combined-fork results do not establish independence.

The Pair rejection fixture does not open a PIN prompt. While that prompt is awaited, the sole event reader is paused, so engine rejection/EOF may be consumed later or lose to cancellation/timeout; this task does not change that ordering. Worker liveness, symmetric IPC limits and generalized bounded desktop reads remain outside scope. A quiet-stream EQ fixture must keep the owned transport alive when testing ownership, and test read expiry separately; a later green run alone does not diagnose an intermittent failure.

## Prepared implementation and executed verification

The prepared implementation is [codex/fix-jsonl-control](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/tree/421e1ea8159803fbc339dff3782b1858e8a797d4), commit `421e1ea8159803fbc339dff3782b1858e8a797d4`, independently based on the original stable source above. Independent final source/regression review found no unresolved findings.

Fresh standalone Release build passed with zero warnings/errors; all **239 Core tests** passed with no skips. Separate isolated WPF runs passed **568 assertions each in 3 catalog/region combinations**, covering English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. These are this branch’s results, separate from combined-fork qualification.

[Exact-source Windows validation](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/actions/runs/38359129170) checked out this commit and passed **53 native tests**, Clippy, native Release build and the executable compatibility audit, plus the branch’s managed build/Core suite. Two existing tests remain ignored: recording-endpoint qualification and the thirty-minute localhost soak.
prefill_parameters.reproduction-steps:
1. Inject the owning-child JSONL rejection: version=1, event="error", code="command_error", channel="ipc", host=null, id="", session_id="", retryable=false, with its original message.
2. Inspect original detail, cleanup and process count in playback/Pair with reconnect enabled.
3. Submit EQ sequences 10/A,9/B,10/B,10/A,11/B through the real handler with a synthetic mailbox.
4. Assert serialized outcomes together with retained preparation/sequence, then valid-command recovery.
prefill_parameters.windows-version: Windows 11 Pro Insider Preview, OS build 26220 (isolated local fixtures); hosted Windows 2025 where stated

records.head: fcded6b2a211db2bade087a17bcd46b0dfabe24d
records.title: Retain local endpoint mute ownership across an interrupted desktop process

prefill_parameters.title: Retain local endpoint mute ownership across an interrupted desktop process
prefill_parameters.bug-description:
The source baseline is original stable main at `cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c`.

## Current behavior

[AudioService.MuteAsync](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/desktop/AirFlash.App/Services/AudioService.cs#L63-L72) captures a playback endpoint's mute bit, sets mute, then stores the original only in an in-memory dictionary. Normal [Restore/disposal](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/desktop/AirFlash.App/Services/AudioService.cs#L74-L105) can attempt the exact prior bit while that desktop process remains alive.

If the desktop is interrupted after mutation, the next process has no retained endpoint/prior-bit ownership information. A setter that changes the endpoint and then throws also occurs before that dictionary entry is written. The Rust worker and WPF process are separate, so engine Stop alone does not persist desktop mute ownership.

This establishes an information/ownership gap. It does not establish that every crash or reboot leaves speakers muted, or that local muting caused a receiver disconnection.

## Reproduction and observation boundary

A deterministic receiver-free fixture can use a fake playback endpoint with original mute false, interrupt after mutation, and construct a new service/coordinator over the same temporary store. Repeat with original mute true. Without retained intent, the new instance cannot recover the exact owned original from the live dictionary.

Additional fixtures can make the setter mutate then throw, fail journal writes/restores, change actual endpoint direction/id, hold another owner's lease or return an unavailable endpoint. Existing synthetic coordinator/file/admission/UI tests execute those interruption and failure boundaries. They do not demonstrate real Windows mute persistence after process kill, reboot or power loss, and no real-device reproduction is required for this issue.

## Expected behavior and bounded fix

Retain actual endpoint identity and the exact original true/false bit in a separate owned recovery journal before endpoint mutation. Establish exclusive cooperating ownership using a lifetime lease and an owner GUID/generation, rather than a PID. An in-memory obligation must also precede a setter that may mutate before throwing.

Normal cleanup continues best-effort exact-bit restoration after worker/process cleanup, including when journal writes fail. Repeated mute must not overwrite an unresolved original. The journal remains separate from preferences and credentials.

Recovery must conservatively distinguish actively owned, pending, restored, corrupt/unsupported/unreadable and unavailable records. A saved bit cannot prove no later user/application change. A differing stale bit therefore needs an explicit revalidated Restore saved/Keep current/Later choice, outside audio/settings/lifecycle locks; Stop must remain accessible. Successful restore followed by failed persistence is known while alive and permits a persistence-only retry; after restart that knowledge may be lost and must remain ambiguous.

Actual opened endpoint direction/id governs access. Recording inputs must never read/write endpoint mute or acquire a new obligation, even when catalog labels disagree. Saved output obligations that open recording/unknown endpoints remain pending. Unresolved recovery blocks admission with local muting enabled; disabling that option permits playback without discarding records.

## Acceptance criteria

- Both original mute bits survive every controlled acquisition/mutation/restore/persistence interruption with an explicit, conservative outcome.
- Intent persists before mutation; a mutating setter failure still receives best-effort tracked exact-bit cleanup.
- Repeated acquisition, multiple entries, lease conflicts and unavailable endpoints cannot overwrite an unresolved original.
- Known restore plus failed Save retries persistence without another endpoint write while alive; restarted ambiguity is not blindly replayed.
- Corrupt, unsupported, unreadable and changed journals remain preserved or blocking; an explicit unsupported-record archive preserves exact bytes before consumption.
- Explicit id mismatch rejects before direction/bit/journal access; opened recording/unknown direction never authorizes mute access or new ownership.
- Modeless review revalidates revision/owner/generation/endpoint/observed state and leaves Stop available; no interaction is held across audio/settings/lifecycle locks.
- Controller admission checks recovery before/after cleanup and before retry; read-only enumeration and diagnostic construction do not initialize recovery.
- Explicit Pair keeps using the applied settings and remains available while an unrelated settings save is pending; adding recovery admission must not make it await that persistence gate.
- Temporary fake endpoint/file/coordinator, Core admission and separate WPF MTA/review assertions verify observable state and failure paths.

Keep normal restoration best effort, without reconnect grace or a hard immediate-completion deadline. Flushing/replacement requests durability but does not prove physical storage behavior. The lease coordinates cooperating AirFlash instances, not arbitrary external writers. Schema 2, JSONL v1 and accessory-keyed encrypted credentials remain unchanged.

## Prepared implementation and executed verification

The prepared implementation is [codex/fix-mute-recovery](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/tree/fcded6b2a211db2bade087a17bcd46b0dfabe24d), commit `fcded6b2a211db2bade087a17bcd46b0dfabe24d`, independently based on the original stable source above. Independent final source/regression review found no unresolved findings.

Fresh standalone Release build passed with zero warnings/errors; all **287 Core tests** passed with no skips. Separate isolated WPF runs passed **629 assertions each in 3 catalog/region combinations**, covering English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. These are this branch’s results, separate from combined-fork qualification.

A new gated app test failed with unchanged branch production code because explicit Pair waited behind unrelated settings persistence. The corrected Pair path preserves readiness/recovery checks and applied settings while reaching the fake pair command before save release; explicit Stop remains available before any PIN prompt. The focused recovery harness now passes **66 assertions**; all endpoints and journal data remain synthetic.
prefill_parameters.reproduction-steps:
1. Use a fake playback endpoint and temporary journal; repeat with original mute false and true.
2. Interrupt after mutation, then construct a new service over the retained store and inspect exact prior-bit ownership.
3. Inject mutating-setter/write/restore failures, lease conflict and unavailable/changed-direction endpoints.
4. Assert conservative recovery, no overwritten obligation and accessible Stop.
No physical reboot or real mute mutation is claimed.
prefill_parameters.windows-version: Windows 11 Pro Insider Preview, OS build 26220 (isolated local fixtures); hosted Windows 2025 where stated

records.head: 6855dfe27b4283a58ede7c37474f3e2aa3c31cf7
records.title: Expose diagnostic copying and distinguish partial from wholly padded capture pulls

prefill_parameters.title: Expose diagnostic copying and distinguish partial from wholly padded capture pulls
prefill_parameters.feature-description:
## Current behavior

Reviewed original stable source: `cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c`.

Settings constructs a localized `CopyDiagnosticsCommand` using the existing serializer and error surface, but no Monitor control binds it. Users cannot invoke that combined-copy action through the visible page.

Native capture already pads a 352-frame pull with zero-valued frames when input is missing and increments `underrun_packets` once for any padding. A pull missing one frame and a pull missing all 352 frames both add one underrun. The amount of substituted audio is discarded, limiting local diagnostic interpretation. This does not establish a network, receiver or acoustic fault.

Relevant original source:

- [Existing diagnostics-copy command](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/desktop/AirFlash.App/ViewModels/SettingsViewModel.cs#L89), [Monitor template](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/desktop/AirFlash.App/Ui/SettingsWindow.xaml#L207).
- [Capture substitution and packet-level accounting](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/native/airflash-engine/src/live.rs#L120-L159), [desktop metric decoding](https://github.com/Ding-Kyoma/AirFlash/blob/cf420d97700463c56adc31408510e8336e99e51c/desktop/AirFlash.Core/SessionController.cs#L361-L367).

## Reproduction and expected behavior

Inspect the realized Monitor page with fake services and an injected diagnostics writer. There is currently no button/binding for the command. Expected behavior is an accessible localized action whose copied text equals the existing serializer snapshot and whose failures use the existing Settings error surface.

Use synthetic output queues at 44.1 and 48 kHz: provide zero, 351 and 352 frames for one pull. Expected added counters are respectively `352/1`, `1/0` and `0/0` for padded frames/wholly padded pulls. Full captured silence remains `0/0`. Accounting occurs before EQ and once per shared pull, before speaker fan-out.

## Bounded fix and acceptance

- Bind an accessible Monitor action to the existing copy command; preserve dispatcher/STA execution. Assert realized visibility, focusability, localization, automation invocation, exact text and error reporting across Idle, Streaming, Error and a fresh attempt. Do not add upload or duplicate report/logging systems.
- Add saturating UInt64 `padded_frames` and `fully_padded_packets`, preserving existing underrun semantics. Reset each worker attempt; retain immutable pre-fault snapshots through retry and later pre-capture failure.
- Parse counters independently as optional full-range UInt64. Missing/invalid fields display unavailable; measured zero remains zero. Preserve old/new JSONL v1 compatibility and show the values in Monitor and diagnostics.
- Cover partial/whole/resumed pulls, real silence, zero gain, EQ tails, saturation, serialization, reset/error snapshots, stale-session filtering and hidden/reopened Monitor refresh. A wholly padded input can still produce an EQ tail; classify its input availability before DSP.
- Keep long values visible under finite WPF layout slots and actual synthetic fractional DPI. Gate/join owned fault cleanup before asserting Copy caused no engine, save or audio side effects.
- Review literal and dynamic localization consumers after final UI changes, then remove only the confirmed unused Chinese entries. Preserve current labels, presets, formats, recording controls and serialized settings compatibility. Avoid tests that merely mirror deleted keys.

## Verification and limits

A [source-equivalent old-accounting control](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/actions/runs/38169613906) fails the decisive padding assertions with controls passing. Historical fractional-DPI fixtures separately distinguish incorrect border arithmetic from actual unwrapped overflow; their corrected assertion uses the parent-assigned finite layout slot without relaxing glyph/viewport checks. These controls remain tied to their exact source, rather than being relabelled as unchanged original source or fresh standalone qualification.

Final standalone managed/native/UI qualification must test the exact prepared branch in all three language catalogs, including regional formatting and synthetic 125% DPI. Combined-fork suite/package results are not branch proof. Padding counts missing frames in the local output-rate capture queue, not network loss or measured acoustic silence. Do not derive a fill percentage from input-rate `capture_frames`; real capture, physical displays and receiver performance remain unqualified. Temporary queues, fake endpoints and an injected writer suffice for the required tests.

## Prepared implementation and executed verification

The prepared implementation is [codex/fix-diagnostics-metrics](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/tree/6855dfe27b4283a58ede7c37474f3e2aa3c31cf7), commit `6855dfe27b4283a58ede7c37474f3e2aa3c31cf7`, independently based on the original stable source above. Independent final source/regression review found no unresolved findings.

Fresh standalone Release build passed with zero warnings/errors; all **233 Core tests** passed with no skips. Separate isolated WPF runs passed **602 assertions each in 6 catalog/region combinations**, covering English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. These are this branch’s results, separate from combined-fork qualification.

[Exact-source Windows validation](https://github.com/ThatMarko/AirFlash/actions/runs/38359132112) checked out this commit and passed **55 native tests**, Clippy, native Release build and the executable compatibility audit, plus the branch’s managed build/Core suite. Two existing tests remain ignored: recording-endpoint qualification and the thirty-minute localhost soak.

Three focused Monitor runs passed **39 assertions each**; three actual owned-window 125% DPI fixtures passed **40 each**, including both widths and full counter glyph visibility. These establish isolated rendering/binding behavior, not physical-display or acoustic qualification.
